text_name.description: The full name of the text in its original script, e.g., 'तैत्तिरीयोपनिषत्'.

structure_levels.description: An ordered list of names for the structural levels, from largest to smallest, e.g., ['Valli', 'Anuvaka', 'Mantra']. The application uses this to parse the hierarchy.

content.description: An array of the top-level structural nodes (e.g., an array of Valli objects).

node.description: A node can be either a structural container or a content leaf.

type.description: The type of this node, matching a name from structure_levels, e.g., 'Valli', 'Anuvaka'.

name.description: The name of this node, e.g., 'Anandavalli'. This is optional.

number.description: The sequential number of this node within its parent, used for URL generation.

oneOf.title: Eager Node
oneOf.description: A node with its children defined directly within the same file.

children.description: An array of child nodes (which can be more structural nodes or leaf nodes).

oneOf.title: Lazy Node
oneOf.description: A node whose children are defined in a separate file, to be loaded on demand.

file.description: The relative path to a JSON file containing the children for this node.

type.description: The type of this leaf node, matching the last name in structure_levels, e.g., 'Mantra', 'Sutra'.

number.description: The sequential number of this leaf within its parent.

text.description: The main content of the leaf node.

commentary_text.description: The associated commentary text. Markdown is supported.
